landmark_cases.title: Trump v. Hawaii
landmark_cases.reason: Authoritative interpretation of 8 U.S.C. § 1182(f), establishing broad presidential discretion to suspend entry of classes of aliens and the deferential standard of review for such actions—central to the court’s stay analysis of the refugee-entry suspension.

landmark_cases.title: Nken v. Holder
landmark_cases.reason: Sets out the four-factor test for a stay pending appeal and emphasizes the primacy of likelihood of success and irreparable injury—framework the court applies in issuing the stay.
